title: A Novel Tran_NAS Method for the Identification of Fe- and Mg-Deficient Pear Leaves from N- and P-Deficient Pear Leaf Data.
summary: A searched neural architecture transfers spectral classification from N/P deficiencies to Fe/Mg deficiencies in pear leaves. The paper reports 89.12% best accuracy and comparison with no transfer; validation remains on the paper’s sampled spectral data. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
